scope: Synthetic email, Slack and Telegram through existing isolated capture, authorization, extraction, visible approvals and acceptance harness. No production data, deployment, model-default, consent or tracing changes.
heldOutStatus: Published idempotently but not executed. Development gate failed; all 36 new held-out cases remain uninspected by live evaluation.
supersededPartialRun: Stopped after the newer implementation was frozen; preserve checkpoint rows and incomplete feedback. This is not a complete run or closure evidence.
scoringChanges: Version 6 made status, assignee and dueAt mandatory expectations (explicit null), reported field/uncertainty mismatches. Version 7 resolves uniquely owned whole seed aliases in task titles. Labels, required edges, field values and thresholds are unchanged; prior scores remain original and are not silently rescored.

reviews.fixtures: Read-only rationale, consistency, family-isolation and scorer review before live runs. Not independent human label validation.
reviews.runtime: Read-only reviews of f4adc66c, 8326482c and final delta; actionable findings fixed and re-reviewed with no remaining actionable findings.

validation.workerFrozenRerun: 159/159 on final implementation commit; all chunks passed.

limitations: Development results are diagnostic. Failed repetitions cannot be selected away; the final gate failed.
Source variants and repeats are correlated, not independent examples.
Controlled synthetic transports, database-only retrieval and isolated queues do not establish production ingestion reliability, vector recall, queue SLA or browser delivery.
Exact supported forms are deterministic and fail closed; this is not universal language understanding.
Field scoring covers status, assignee, deadline and required graph links, not every possible canonical field such as priority or prose.
Initial dirty diagnostic predates final scorer wording; its recorded output is retained as originally emitted.
